projection-booth.name: Projection booth with projector and service stairs

design.brief: Detailed 288-seat neighbourhood cinema with burgundy raked seating, dark acoustic finishes, warm concessions lobby and illuminated brick frontage. Auditorium clear height approximately 7.8 m; lobby ceiling 4 m.

circulation.notes: Central south entrance leads through entry to lobby. Two rear auditorium doors and four side emergency exits remain clear. Seating terraces have side access and rear wheelchair recesses.

furniture.intent: 7 m concession counter along north wall between auditorium doors
Scanner podium beside west auditorium door
WC clear of door and transfer area
WC clear of door and transfer area

programme.purpose: 288 seats, screen apron, stepped internal aisles, side routes and rear wheelchair bays

tier-floor-1.name: Carpeted raked seating floor with twelve terraces

intent.text: Dim, readable cinema auditorium with the screen brightest; warm welcoming lobby and illuminated entrance.

cinema-equipment.description: Contemporary cinema equipment: vented digital projector, illuminated countertop popcorn cabinet, emergency exit pictogram, recycling bin, or sloping metal handrail.

color.description: Projector housing, cabinet plinth, sign frame, bin body or handrail finish

length.description: Handrail length along Z in meters

rise.description: Handrail elevation increase from -Z to +Z in meters

cinema-menu-board.description: Wall-mounted cinema concessions menu with a black metal frame, burgundy panel, warmly illuminated geometric lettering, prices, and popcorn and drink illustrations. Front faces +Z; default size is 1.2 × 0.75 × 0.05 meters.

cinema-projection-beam.description: Extremely faint pale-blue projection envelope, with no opaque surfaces, end caps, or colliders. Before build: lens center (0,2.55,0), screen center (0,2.55,-length); screen is 12 m wide and 5.1 m tall, lens aperture is 0.12 m square. api.build() centers the bounds in X/Z and places the bottom at Y=0: resulting lens center is (0,2.55,+length/2), screen center is (0,2.55,-length/2). To place the lens at a desired world point, translate the built object by that point minus (0,2.55,length/2), then apply the desired orientation about the lens.

length.description: Distance from lens to screen along negative Z, in metres.

cinema-projection-booth.description: Charcoal acoustic cinema projection booth with a serviced digital projector, optical glazing, warm interior lamp, rear service door, and an integrated east-side switchback stair. Stair foot is at ground, booth floor at 4 m, and roof at 6.7 m; no signage.

rearDoorAngle.description: Rear service door opening in degrees
